scientific_integrity: Claims concern two analytic asymptotic regimes and are supported by a proof with finite numerical checks as corroboration; no independent scientific audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Absolute (unstandardized) variance and mean are compared for the uniform-launch symmetric run-and-tumble point-target model at fixed target reactivity. Variance-minimizer uniqueness is proved only for sufficiently weak or sufficiently strong reactivity; no intermediate uniqueness or single-crossing assertion is made. The exact moment formulas used are published prior work. Publication priority remains subject to independent comparison with unindexed work.
title: Reactivity reverses the ordering of mean-optimal and variance-optimal run-and-tumble search speeds
